proposed_widenings.name: negate_incoming_critical_hit
proposed_widenings.justification: The surface has outgoing crit-range modification for the wearer/attacker, but no honest way to express a passive defensive rule that converts critical hits against the wearer into normal hits.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While you're wearing it, any Critical Hit against you becomes a normal hit.

notes: Top-level fit exists as a passive magic item, but the core mechanic is not representable with any existing EffectAtom in the current surface or v4 taxonomy. No Dhall/JSON/trace content file was authored.
